question: Which Law of Newton states that for every action (force) in nature there is an equal and opposite reaction?
solution:
The correct answer is __**3rd.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Newton's 3rd Law of Motion states that for every action, there is an** equal and opposite reaction.**
 
• This means that when **one object applies a force on a second object**, the** second object applies an equal and opposite force back on the first.**
 
• The law is commonly observed in scenarios such as a rocket launch, where the action of gas expelling downwards results in the rocket moving upwards.
 
• The **forces always occur in pairs**, and they act on different bodies.
